component.name: ferge
component.summary: Move files between your computer and servers

description.p: ferge is a fast, keyboard-first file transfer client. This computer is on the left, a server on the right, and files go between them, or between two servers, with copy and paste, a key press or drag and drop.

ul.li: SFTP with your SSH configuration, keys, agent and known hosts
Folders with 100,000 entries scroll, sort and filter without delay
A transfer queue that pauses, resumes within a file and survives a restart
Direct copies between two servers that never pass through this computer
Working as root through sudo, without a root login
Previews of text, pictures, spreadsheets, office documents and PDF pages
Saved passwords in the desktop's keyring
